Wildwood Warren

Pick an animal, roam the island, gather gems, and fill a burrow with furniture you actually chose yourself.

An original game in the spirit of animal-avatar worlds. Not affiliated with Animal Jam or WildWorks; every creature, item, and pixel here is made from scratch.

How to play

  • W A S D or arrow keys to walk. Shift to run.
  • Space to hop. On a phone, use the stick and the Hop button.
  • Drag anywhere to swing the camera. Scroll or pinch to zoom.
  • Walk into a gem to pocket it. They grow back.
  • Stand near a house door to read what it has. Some houses have three floors, with stairs inside, and every floor can be decorated.
  • Slides from the shops can be placed in any home. Walk to the base and press E to ride!
  • Walk up to a stall, the wagon, the race arch, or your burrow door and press E.
  • Races: one lap, six rings, three rivals. Run through each glowing ring in order.
  • Cake Stack: tap or press Space to drop a layer. Overhang gets trimmed off, so line it up.
  • Barnaby trades furniture and hats. He only takes things sitting in your crate, not things already placed.
  • Seashell Bay: take the east pier (60 gems the first time). Buy a beach den, browse the shops, crack mystery clams at Pearl's, and check Nerissa's curios. They change every day.
  • Minnows from fishing can be swapped at Finn's for gems or things nobody else sells.
  • Homes: buy as many dens as you like. Every one has its own room and its own furniture. The Voyage Board lists them all so you can hop home.
  • Villagers: press E near anyone to chat, give gifts, play Rock Paper Scissors, run errands and make friends. Hearts unlock rewards.
  • Taverns: order food for speed boosts, play dice, cups, cards and arm wrestling, and befriend the barkeep to open the secret back room.
  • Homes button: tap H or the Homes button to step inside any home you own, from anywhere. Big houses have extra wings, some have a waterslide (climb the ladder and ride!), and the two-story ones have an upstairs.
  • Taverns are real buildings now: walk in, order at the bar, play at the games table, or try the back room door.
  • Island relics: three glowing relics hide on every island. Every island also has a party square with a daily prize.
  • Your animal, gems, burrow and every den you own are saved in this browser.
